rows.reference: It could mark the end of a Ryder Cup career that has never quite matched the heights of his individual record.

rows.source: Mickelson ní ìborí 18. ìpàdánù 20 àti ìdọ́gba méje, lọ́ọ̀tọ́ Furyk sọ pé wíwà níbẹ̀ rẹ̀ mú ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ìyàtọ̀ kan bá àwọn alájọṣepọ̀.
rows.output: Mickelson has a 18-hole lead. Furyk, who is in second place, said that being there has made him feel a lot of things with his fellow competitors.
rows.reference: Mickelson has 18 wins, 20 losses and seven halves, though Furyk said his presence brought some intangibles to the team.

rows.source: "Ó jẹ́ apanilẹ́rìn ín, ó jẹ́ aláwàdà, ó nífẹ́ láti máa ṣ’ẹ̀fẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ènìyàn, àti pé ọkùnrin tí ó dára ni látin í nínú yàrá alájọṣepọ̀,” ó ṣàlàyé.
rows.output: He was a prankster, he was funny, he loved to mess around with people, and he was a great guy in the bedroom, he explained.
rows.reference: "He's funny, he's sarcastic, witty, likes to poke fun at people, and he's a great guy to have in the team room," he explained.

rows.source: "Mo rò pé àwọn àkópa tó kéré díẹ̀ gbádùn ara wọn pẹ̀lú rẹ̀, bakan náà, ní ọ̀ṣẹ̀ yìí, tí ó jẹ́ ohun tí ó dùn mọ́ni láti rí.
rows.output: I think that a few of the characters enjoyed themselves with him, also, in this episode, which is something that I find very enjoyable to see.
rows.reference: "I think the younger players had fun having a go at him, as well, this week, which was fun to see.

rows.source: Ó pèsè ọ̀pọ̀ ǹkan jú kíkopa nìkan lọ."
rows.output: He provided a lot more than just a role.
rows.reference: He provides a lot more than just play."

rows.source: Olórí yúròpù Thomas Bjorn mọ̀ pé ìléwájú tó pọ̀ má tó tán.
rows.output: European Tour leader Thomas Bjorn knows that the lead is not too big.
rows.reference: Europe captain Thomas Bjorn knows big lead can soon disappear

rows.source: Thomas Bjorn, olórí tí yúrópù, mọ̀ nípa ìrírí pé ìléwájú níwọ́nba tó súnmọ́ ọjọ̀ ìkẹhìn ẹlẹ́nìkan fún Ìfe ẹ̀yẹ Ryder le ṣàdédé yí padà sí ohun tí kò ní rọrùn.
rows.output: Thomas Bjorn, the European captain, knows that the experience of coming so close to the last man standing for the Ryder Cup can turn into something that is not easy.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn, the European captain, knows from experience that a sizeable lead heading into the last-day singles in the Ryder Cup can easily turn into an uncomfortable ride.

rows.source: The Dane fakọyọ ní ọdún 1997 ní Valderrama, níbití Seve Ballesteros ti ní àmì ayò márùn lórí akẹgbẹ́ wọn láti Amerika, ṣùgbọ́n ṣóńsó imú wọn ní wọ́n fí gbégbá orókè ní ìlà-ìparí tí wọ́n sì borí pẹ̀lú 14½-13½.
rows.output: In 1997, the Dane won in Valderrama, where Seve Ballesteros had a five-stroke mark on their American partner, but they were disqualified in the final round and won with 14½-13½.
rows.reference: The Dane made his debut in the 1997 match at Valderrama, where a side captained by Seve Ballesteros held a five-point advantage over the Americans but only just got over the finishing line with their noses in front by the narrowest of margins, winning 14½-13½.

rows.source: “Kí ó máa rán ara rẹ létí pé a gbégbá orókè ní Valderrama; a gbìyànjú Brookline bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé a fìdí rẹmi, ṣùgbọ́n ní Valderrama a bórí gíníngínín. Bjorn, sọ pé nígbàtí òun wó ìdíje àwọn kíílàsì 2018 bí wọ́n ṣe borí pẹ̀lú 5-3 ní ọjọ́ Furaide àti ní àná bí wọ́n ṣe borí Le Golf National pẹ̀lú 10-6.
rows.output: "Remember that we were the favorites in Valderrama; we tried Brookline as well, but in Valderrama we were the ones who were favored. Bjorn said that when he was in the 2018 class, they were the favorites with a 5-3 victory on Friday and the day before they were the favorites at Le Golf National with a 10-6 victory.
rows.reference: "You keep reminding yourself that we had a big lead at Valderrama; we had a big lead at Brookline, where we lost, and at Valderrama, where we won, but only just," said Bjorn, pictured, after watching the Class of 2018 win 5-3 both on Friday and yesterday to lead 10-6 at Le Golf National.

rows.source: Fún ìdí èyí ìtàn máa ṣàfihàn fún mi àti ẹnikẹ́ni nínú alájọṣepọ̀ pe kò tíì tán síbẹ.
rows.output: This story will show me and anyone else in the partnership that it's not over yet.
rows.reference: So history will show me and everybody on that team that this is not over.

rows.source: Wàá lọ̀ bí ó ṣe yẹ jùlọ́ ní ọ̀la.
rows.output: Act in the best interest of the future.
rows.reference: You go full bore tomorrow.

rows.source: Jáde síta níbẹ̀yẹn kí o ṣe ohun tí ó yẹ
rows.output: Get out of there and do the right thing
rows.reference: Get out there and do all the right things.

rows.source: Eyi koiti Pati titi waa ni koko Lori boodu.
rows.output: This is not a party matter, but a matter of principle.
rows.reference: This is not over till you've got the points on the board.

rows.source: A ní àfojúsùn, ìyẹn ni láti gbìyànjú láti gba ife ẹ̀yẹ yìí, àtipé ibẹ̀yẹn gan an ní àfojúsùn wà’.
rows.output: Our goal is, that is to try to win this trophy, and that is our main goal.
rows.reference: We have a goal, and that is to try to win this trophy, and that's where the focus stays.

rows.source: Mo ti sọ mláti ìbẹ̀rẹ̀, Mo gbájúmọ́ àwọn èléré ìdárayá 12 tí wọ́n wà lápá ọ̀dọ̀ wa, ṣùgbọ́n a mọ ohun tí ó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ dáadáa ní apá kejì wa -. àwọn eléré ìdárayá tó dára jùlọ ní àgbáyé”
rows.output: I have mentioned from the beginning, I am focused on the 12 athletes in our area, but we know what is happening well in the other side - the best athletes in the world.
rows.reference: I've said all along, I focus on the 12 players that are in our side, but we are so well aware of what's standing across on the other side - the greatest players in the world."

rows.source: Pẹ̀lú bí inú rẹ̀ ṣe dùn lórí i bí àwọn elére ìdárayá rẹ̀ ṣe fakọyọ sí lórí pápá gọ́ọ̀fù, Bjorn ṣàláyè sí wípé: "Èmi kò ní síwájú ara mi lórí eléyìí.
rows.output: With how much joy he was on the golf course, Bjorn revealed that he was: "I'm not going to be able to top this."
rows.reference: Delighted how his players have performed on a tough golf course, Bjorn added: "I would never get ahead of myself in this.

rows.source: Ohun to yàtọ̀ pátápátá ni ọ̀lá jẹ́.
rows.output: The most important thing is respect.
rows.reference: Tomorrow's a different beast.

rows.source: Ọ̀lá jẹ́ ìṣesí ẹ̀nì kọ̀ọ̀kan to ń farahàn, àtipé èyí jẹ́ ohun ti ó yàtọ̀ gedégbé láti ṣe.
rows.output: Pride is a personal attitude, and this is something that is very different from the way to do things.
rows.reference: Tomorrow is the individual performances that come forward, and that is a different thing to do.

rows.source: Ohun tí ó dára ni láti wà pẹ̀lú enìkan nígbàtí àwọn n[kan bá ńlọ dáradára, ṣùgbọ́n, nígbàtí o ẹ̀nìkọ̀ọ̀kan bá dá wà, nigbànáa ní ìdánwò àdánán máa ṣẹ̀lẹ̀ sí ọ̀ gẹ́gẹ́bí eléré ìdárayá gọ́ọ̀fù.
rows.output: It's good to be with someone when they're doing well, but when they're down, then you're tested as a partner like a golf caddie.
rows.reference: It's great to be out there with a partner when things are going good, but when you're out there individually, then you're tested to the full of your capacity as a golfer.

rows.source: Ìyẹn ní ìfiránṣẹ́ tí o níláti fi ránṣẹ́ sí àwọn elérée ìdárayá, èyí ní láti mú ohun tó dára jùlọ jáde lára rẹ ní ọ̀la.
rows.output: That is the message you have to send to the athletes, in order to bring out the best in them in the future.
rows.reference: That's the message that you need to get across to players, is get the best out of yourself tomorrow.

rows.source: Nísìnyí, o fi ẹnìkejì rẹ sẹ́hìn ó sì níláti lọ mọ́ bí ó sẹ máa mu ohun tó dára jù jáde lát ara rẹ̀, bákan náà."
rows.output: Now, you put your second one behind and you have to figure out how to get the best out of yourself, too."
rows.reference: Now, you leave your partner behind and he has to go and get the best out of himself, as well."

rows.source: Ní ìdàyàtọ̀ sí Bjorn, opposite number Jim Furyk tí ó jẹ́ nọ́ńbà ìdàkejì máa ma wá àwọn eléré ìdárayá rẹ̀ láti le ní ìṣesí tó dára ní ẹlẹ́nìkọ̀ọ̀kan ju bí wọ́n ṣe ṣe lọ ní aláṣepọ̀, àwọn tó dáyàtọ̀ Jordan Spieth àti Justin Thomas, tí wọ́n ní máàkì mẹ́ta nínú mẹ́rin
rows.output: In contrast to Bjorn, his opposite number Jim Furyk, who is also a number two, would often bring his players to have a better individual performance than they did in their partnership, the contrasting duo Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas, who have three majors between them.
rows.reference: In contrast to Bjorn, opposite number Jim Furyk will be looking for his players to perform better individually than they did as partners, the exceptions being Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas, who picked up three points out of four.

rows.source: Furyk funra ara rẹ ti wà ní apá méjèèjì ibi ti àwọn ọjọ́ tó kẹ́hìn ńlá ti ṣàdédé yípadà, lẹ́yìn tí ó ti jẹ́ ara àwọn alájọṣepọ̀tó tò borí ní kí ó tó parí rẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́bí aláìláṣeyọrí ní Yúrópù mú kí “Ìyànu ńlá ní Mẹ̀dínà” ti ara rẹ̀ jáde.
rows.output: Furyk was in both parts of the world where the last great days of change had taken place, after having been a partner in the great European failure, which made his own "Great Mystery in the Middle East" emerge.
rows.reference: Furyk himself has been on both ends of those big last-day turnarounds, having been part of the winning team at Brookline before ending up a loser as Europe pulled off the "Miracle at Medinah."

rows.source: “Mo ránti gbogbo gbolohun kọ̀ọ̀kan tó jẹ jáde nínú rẹ̀,” ó sọ̀rọ̀ ní ìfèsì sí ìbéèrè bí Ben Crenshaw, olórí ilé ní 1999, ṣe ṣàtòjọ̀ àwọn eléré ìdárayá rẹ̀ lásìkò ìgbà ìkẹ̀hìn náà.
rows.output: "I remember every word of it," he said in response to a question about how Ben Crenshaw, the leader of the 1999 team, had listed his players during the final game.
rows.reference: "I remember every damn word of it," he said in reply to being asked how Ben Crenshaw, the captain in 1999, had rallied his players heading into the last day.

rows.source: "A ní ìfigagbága 12 tó ṣe pàtàkì lóla, ṣùgbọ́n o máa fẹ́ láti tètè dé ibi ìyára bẹ̀rẹ̀ bí i ọ ṣe rí i ní Brookline, bí o ṣe rí i ní Medinah.
rows.output: "We have 12 important goals for the year, but you want to get to the first one as quickly as possible, as you see in Brookline, as you see in Medinah.
rows.reference: "We have 12 important matches tomorrow, but you'd like to get off to that fast start like you saw at Brookline, like you saw at Medinah.

rows.source: Nígbà abala kan bá ń lọ dáadáa, ó máa rán àwon ìfigagbaga ààrín lọ́wọ̀.
rows.output: When one part of the body is healthy, it can send a healthy message to the other parts.
rows.reference: When that momentum gets going one way, it puts a lot of pressure on those middle matches.

rows.source: A ṣètò ìtọ̀ gbọorọ̀ wa lórí ìlà lọ́wọ̀ọ̀wọ́ tí a sí mú kí àwọn ẹni tiwa jẹ́ jádení ọ̀nà àrà ọ̀tọ̀ tí ó wù wá, o mọ̀, a ń gbìyànjú láti pidán lọla."
rows.output: We have set our sights on the shore, and we have made our way to the path that is right for us, you know, we are trying to make a living.
rows.reference: We set up our line-up accordingly and put the guys out in the fashion that we felt like, you know, we're trying to make some magic tomorrow."

rows.source: Thomas ní ó gba iṣẹ́ pàtàkì lórí dídarí ìjagbara àti kíkojú Rory Mcllroy nínú ìfigagbaga to le jù, Pẹ̀lú Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahim, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulte tThomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter tí wọ́n jẹ́ ara Yúrópù núnú ìdámejì ìtòléra láti òkè.
rows.output: Thomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter all in the European team.
rows.reference: Thomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter the other Europeans in the top half of the order.

rows.source: "Mo ti wà pẹ̀lú àwọn ọ̀wọ̀ àwọn ẹni wọ̀nyìí nínú ìtòléra yìí nítorípé mo rò pé ó kó àkóyáwọ́,” Bjorn ló sọ bẹ́ẹ̀ nípa àwọn àkopa ẹlẹ́nìkọ̀ọ̀an rẹ̀.
rows.output: "I've been with these people in this camp because I think it's a great opportunity," Bjorn said about his fellow competitors.
rows.reference: "I went with this group of guys in this order because I think it covers all the way through," said Bjorn of his singles selections.

rows.source: Ọkọ̀ ogun ojú omi tuntun ti Germany ti di sísún síwájú lẹ́ẹ̀kan síi
rows.output: The new German warship has been launched for the first time
rows.reference: Germany's new warship postponed yet again

rows.source: Àkọ̀tun Ọkọ̀ ogun ojú omi ti Jámáànù ní ó yẹ kí ó ti di fífi lọ́lẹ̀ ní ọdún 2014 láti pààrọ̀ àwọn ọkọ̀ ogun ojú omi Sáà-ogún Dúkùú, ṣùgbọ́n kò ní rí bẹ́ẹ̀ títí di, ó kéré jù, ọdún í ó ń bọ̀ nítorí àwọn èròjà tó ti bàjẹ̀ àti àwọn ìnáwò tó ti ṣarajọ, ilé iṣẹ́ ìròyìn abẹ́léni ó jábọ̀ rẹ̀.
rows.output: The German Navy's Type 214 submarine should have been decommissioned in 2014 to make way for the new Type 212A submarines, but it will not be until at least next year due to damaged components and a lack of funding, the German Defense Ministry said.
rows.reference: German Navy's newest frigate should have been commissioned in 2014 to replace ageing Cold War-era warships, but it won't be there until at least the next year due to faulty systems and snowballing cost, local media reported.

rows.source: Síṣàfilọ́lẹ̀ "Rheinland-Pfalz," olórí ọkọ̀ ogun ojú omi tí ìsọ̀rí fírígéètì Baden-Wuerttemberg tuntun nini, ni ó ti di sísún ṣíwájú títi di ìdájì àkọ́kọ́ ọdún 2019, gẹ́gẹ́bi ìwé ìròyìn Die Zeit ṣe sọ tí ọgá ológun kan sọ.
rows.output: The launch of "Rheinland-Pfalz," the new flagship of the Baden-Wuerttemberg military, is ahead of schedule until the first half of 2019, as reported by the newspaper Die Zeit, which quoted a military official.
rows.reference: Commissioning of the "Rheinland-Pfalz," the lead ship of the brand new Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates, has now been postponed until the first half of 2019, according to Die Zeit newspaper citing a military spokesman.

rows.source: Ó yẹ kí ọkọ̀ ojú omi nlá náà darapọ̀ ní 2014, ṣùgbọ̀n àwọn wàhálà ìṣòro lẹ́yìn ìfakalẹ̀ rẹ̀ ní ó mú kí ìgbẹ́kẹ́lé nínú itẹ̀síwájú àkànṣe iṣẹ́ náà já sófo.
rows.output: The large ship was supposed to be assembled in 2014, but the troubles following its launch led to a loss of confidence in the project's progress.
rows.reference: The vessel should have joined the Navy in 2014, but the troubling post-delivery issues plagued the fate of the ambitious project.

rows.source: Àwọn ọkọ̀ ojú omi ńlá mẹ́rin ti ìsọ̀rí Baden-Wuerttemberg tí Àwọn ọmọ ogún ojú omi sànwó fún ;áti 2007 máa wá gẹ́gẹ́bí arọ́pò sí ìṣọ̀rí àwọn fírígéétì Bremen.
rows.output: Four large patrol ships of the Baden-Wuerttemberg class, which were built for the German Navy, and since 2007 have been used as replacements for the Bremen class frigates.
rows.reference: The four Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels the Navy ordered back in 2007 will come as replacement to the ageing Bremen-class frigates.

rows.source: Ó yé wá pé wọ́n máa ṣàfihàn Kanọ́ọ̀nù tó lágbara,ọ̀wọ́ àwọn mísáìlì aṣòdì-sí-bàálù àti aṣòdì-sí-ọkọ̀ orí omi àti àwọn ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ nǹka ìjagun mìíràn, bíi rédà, ínfúrárẹ́ẹ̀dì àti àwọn ìfọ́wọ́sí abáfẹfẹ́ṣiṣẹ́.
rows.output: They will also demonstrate the latest in guided missiles and other military technology, such as radar, infrared and laser-guided weapons.
rows.reference: It is understood they will feature a powerful cannon, an array of anti-aircraft and anti-ship missiles as well as some stealth technologies, such as reduced radar, infrared and acoustic signatures.

rows.source: Àwọn ohun pàtàkì mìràn gẹ́gẹ́bí ìgbà ìṣàbójútó lóòrèkóòrè - p yẹ kó ṣeéṣe láti ṣàfillẹ̀ awọn fírígéètì fún bí ọdún méjì jìnnà sí ìbúdó \kọ ojú omi.
rows.output: Other important factors, such as the need for refrigeration, may make it possible to store food for up to two years in a bunker.
rows.reference: Other important features include longer maintenance periods - it should be possible to deploy the newest frigates for up to two years away from home ports.

rows.source: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, ìdádúró gbogbo ìgbà túmọ̀ sí wípé àwọn ọkọ̀ ojú omi ìṣaajú - tí wọn sọ pé ó jẹ́ kí ilẹ̀ jámánì ní agbara ní òkè òkun - ti máa di èyí tí kò bá ìgbà mu mọ́ ní àkókò tí wọ́n bá wọ iṣẹ́. Die Zelt ló pe àkíyèsí yìí.
rows.output: However, the total stoppage means that the old ships - which are said to give the Germans a monopoly on the high seas - will have to be replaced by new ones at a time when they are not in use. The Zelt refers to this attention.
rows.reference: However, continuous delays mean that the cutting-edge warships - said to allow Germany to project power overseas - will already become outdated by the time they enter service, Die Zeit notes.

rows.source: Fírígèètì F125 tí ó kùnà náà gba gogbo ìròyìn kan ní ọdún tó kọjá, nígbàtí Àwọn ọmọ ogun ojú omi kọ̀ jàlẹ̀ láti ṣafilọlẹ̀ ọkọ̀ ojú omi ńlá náà tí wọ́n sì dá a padà sí ìlé iṣẹ́ ọkọ̀ ojú omi Blohm & Voss ní Hamburb.
rows.output: The failed F125 project was a total loss for the year, while the Navy refused to launch the large aircraft carrier and returned it to the Blohm & Voss shipyard in Hamburg.
rows.reference: The ill-fated F125 frigate made headlines last year, when the German Navy officially refused to commission the vessel and returned it to Blohm & Voss shipyard in Hamburg.

rows.source: Èyí jẹ ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ tí Àwọn ọ́mọ ogun ojú omi máa dá ọkọ̀ ojú omi padà fún ilé iṣẹ́ ọkọ̀ ojú omi ṣiṣe lẹ́yìn tí wọn ti fà á kalẹ̀.
rows.output: This is the first time that the Navy's shipbuilding program has returned a ship to the shipyard for repair after it was launched.
rows.reference: This was the first time the Navy has returned a ship to a shipbuilder after delivery.

rows.source: Díẹ̀ ní a mọ̀ nípa ìdí tí ọkọ̀ ojú omi náà fi di dídá padà, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn oníwè ìròyìn jámànù sọ díẹ nípa “àṣìṣe sọ́fútìwíà àti hádìwíà” tí ó mú kí ọkọ̀ ìfijagun ojú omi náà má wúlò tí ó bá di lílò ní ojú ogun.
rows.output: Some things are known about why the ship was sent back, but the German press reported little about the "technical and tactical errors" that made the aircraft carrier unsuitable for use in the war.
rows.reference: Little was known about the reasons behind the return, but German media cited a number of crucial "software and hardware defects" that made the warship useless if deployed on a combat mission.

rows.source: Àìpé sọ́fùtiwìà jẹ́ ohún tí ó ṣe pàtàkì gan nítorí awọn 120 awakọ̀ ojú omi ni wọ́n máa wa ìsọ̀rí ọkọ̀ ojú omi ńlá Baden-Wuerttemberg-class náà - èyí tí ó jẹ́ ìdájí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ nínú àwọn fírígéètì ìsọ̀rí Bremen àtijọ́.

rows.source: Ótún sọ síwájú pé “nípa” pé Toyota UK ti sọ fún BBC pé tí Bírítéénì bá fi EU sílẹ̀ láì ní àdéhùn ìsòwò tó só pọ̀, ó máa ṣe ìdádúró ìgbéjáde-iṣẹ̀ ní ilé iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ní Burnaston, ní ẹ̀bá Derby.

rows.output: But let's not forget that I always want to remind the media of what's going on.

rows.output: They are not interested in the one who has been wronged, who has been destroyed, who has been made a laughing stock, who has been made a fool of, who has been made a slave. They are interested in power and control. That is what they want, and we will not give it to them.

rows.output: The Democrats, he said, are on a mission to "abolish and disband."

rows.output: "And you've seen that in the last four days," he said, calling the Democrats "angry and bitter and dishonest and untrustworthy."
rows.reference: "And you see that over the last four days," he said, calling the Democrats "angry and mean and nasty and untruthful."

rows.output: When the Momentum rebels within my own party voted to censure me, it was not surprising.
rows.reference: When Momentum's activists in my local party voted to censure me, it was hardly a surprise.

rows.source: Tun da yake, ni ne mafi sabo a wani layi na mambobin Labour na majalisa da za a faɗa musu ba a maraba da mu - dukka saboda faɗan abi da ke zuciyarmu.
rows.output: As for me, I am the most recent in a line of Labour members of parliament to be told that we are not welcome - all because of the anger that is in our hearts.
rows.reference: After all, I'm the latest in a line of Labour MPs to be told we are not welcome - all for speaking our minds.

rows.source: Abokiyata a majalisa Joan Ryan ta sami irin wulakanci saboda ta tsaya tsayin daka tana faɗa da ra’ayin ƙin Yahudawa.
rows.output: My colleague in the House of Commons, Joan Ryan, has been subjected to a barrage of abuse because she has been steadfast in her opposition to anti-Semitism.
rows.reference: My parliamentary colleague Joan Ryan received similar treatment because she resolutely stood up to antisemitism.

rows.source: A nawa misalin, batun dakatarwar ya soke ni don ƙin yarda da Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.output: For example, the issue of suspension has been used to exclude me for refusing to support Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.reference: In my case, the censure motion criticised me for disagreeing with Jeremy Corbyn.

rows.source: A kan amfani na wani ƙudurin tattalin arzikin mai kyau, a kan tsaron ƙasa, a kan Turai, abin takaici batutuwa iri guda wanda a kai Jeremy ya ƙi yarda da shugabanni da suka wuce.
rows.output: On the use of sound economic policy, on national security, on Europe, there are the same issues that Jeremy has refused to accept from previous leaders.
rows.reference: On the importance of a responsible economic policy, on national security, on Europe, ironically similar issues on which Jeremy disagreed with previous leaders.

rows.source: Sanarwa don taron Labour ta Nottingham ta Gabas a ranar Juma’a ta kawo cewa, “muna son tarukan su zama a haɗe da  ma’ana.”
rows.output: Announcement for the Labour Party's East Nottingham meeting on Friday stated, "we want the meetings to be inclusive and meaningful."
rows.reference: The notice for the Nottingham East Labour meeting on Friday stated that "we want the meetings to be inclusive and productive."

rows.source: Ga mafi yawan na shekaru takwas ɗin a matsayi na mamban Labour a majalisa, haka dai yake daren tarukan GC.
rows.output: For the majority of the past eight years, I have been a member of the Labour Party in the House of Commons, and so it is on the evening of the GC meetings.
rows.reference: For most of my eight years as the local Labour MP, the Friday night GC meetings have been exactly that.

rows.source: Abin takaici a yau, ba shi ne fasalin taruka da yawa kuma alkawari na siyasa ta “ihsani, hankali” tuni aka manta idan, ma, an taɓa farawa.
rows.output: It's a pity today, it's not a feature of many summits and the political promise of "ihsani, hankali" has already been forgotten if, indeed, it was ever started.
rows.reference: Sadly today, it is not the tone of many meetings and the promise of "kinder, gentler" politics has long been forgotten if, indeed, it ever began.

rows.source: Yana ƙara zama a bayyane fili cewa ba a haƙuri da ra’ayoyi daban-daban a cikin jam’iyyar Labour kuma ana hukunta kowane ra’ayi a kan ko zai karɓu ga shugabannin jam’iyyar.
rows.output: It is becoming increasingly clear that there is no tolerance for different views within the Labour Party and that any dissenting view is punished by being denied acceptance by the party leaders.
rows.reference: It has become increasingly apparent that differing views are not tolerated in the Labour party and every opinion is judged on whether it is acceptable to the party leadership.

rows.source: Wannan ya fara jim kaɗan bayan Jeremy ya zama shugaba, don abokan aiki da nake jin a da muna da irin mahangar siyasa sun fara tsammani zan yi wani juyi da daukan matsaya da ba zan taɓa yarda da su ba - ko a kan tsaron ƙasa ko kasuwa guda ta Tarayyar Turai.
rows.output: This started a little while after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues who I used to work with and who had a similar political perspective to me began to expect that I would take a position on something that I would never agree with - either on national security or a single European Union market.
rows.reference: This started shortly after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues with whom I had previously thought I shared a similar political outlook began expecting me to do a U-turn and take positions I would never have otherwise agreed with - whether on national security or the EU single market.

rows.source: A kodayaushe na yi magana a cikin jama’a - kuma ba ruwan haƙiƙa abin da na ce - kawai sai tarun cin mutunci a kan kafar sadar zumunta ana kira ga sake zaɓe, ana watsi da siyasar ta tsakiya, ana faɗa mun cewa ya kamata na zama ba na cikin jam’iyyar Labour.
rows.output: I have always spoken in the public - and not really what I said - just a bunch of trolls on social media are called for a re-election, the politics of the center are ignored, and we are told that I should not be part of the Labour Party.
rows.reference: Whenever I speak publicly - and it doesn't really matter what I say - there follows a tirade of abuse on social media calling for deselection, denouncing the politics of the centre, telling me I should not be in the Labour party.

rows.source: Kuma wannan ba kawai abin da na gani ne ba.
rows.output: And this is not the only thing I have seen.
rows.reference: And that is not just my experience.

rows.source: Haƙiƙa, na san na ti sa’a sosai fiye da sauran abokan aikina saboda umarce-umarce da ake fuskantowa a kaina sukan zama na siyasa.
rows.output: Of course, I know I've been given a lot more leeway than my other colleagues because the demands placed on me are often political in nature.
rows.reference: Indeed, I know I am more fortunate than some of my colleagues as the comments directed at me tend to be political.

rows.source: Ina cikin dan shayi na ra’ayin kwarewa da ƙudurtawa ta waɗannan abokan aikin waɗanda ke fuskantar wani cin mutunci ta fuska jinsi ko bambancin launin fata a kowace rana amma ba su taɓa gudu ba.
rows.output: I am in a state of tea with the experience and determination of these colleagues who are facing a daily humiliation based on gender or race, but they never run.
rows.reference: I am in awe of the professionalism and determination of those colleagues who face a torrent of sexist or racist abuse every day but never shy away.

rows.source: Daya daga cikin ɓangarorin abu mafi ɓata rai a wannan lokaci na siyasa shi ne yadda lebur-lebur na cin mutunci suna zama ruwan dare.
rows.output: One of the most depressing aspects of this time in politics is how the level of corruption has become the norm.
rows.reference: One of the most disappointing aspects of this era of politics is how levels of abuse have become normalised.

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn ya ce a mako da ya wuce cewa ya kamata jam’iyyar Labour ta samar da wata al’adar haƙuri.
rows.output: Jeremy Corbyn said last week that the Labour Party should be a culture of tolerance.
rows.reference: Jeremy Corbyn claimed last week that the Labour party should foster a culture of tolerance.

rows.source: Abin da yake zahiri shi ne yanzu mu ba wancan babbar majami’ar ne ba da kowane batu na “ba a yarda da iyawa ba” ko canjin dokokin zaɓe a ce jam’iyya tana zama karama.
rows.output: What is really happening is that we are no longer the big church on the corner of "unlimited power" or the change in election laws that say the party is becoming small.
rows.reference: The reality is we are no longer that broad church and with every "no-confidence" motion or change of selection rules the party becomes narrower.

rows.source: Na sha samun sharawa da yawa a cikin shekaru biyu da suka wuce ana kira da na yi shiru, kar na yi surutu shi ke nan zan zama “ba wata matsala.”
rows.output: I have received many invitations in the past two years to be silent, not to make noise, that I am just a "non-issue."
rows.reference: I have had lots of advice over the past two years urging me to keep my head down, not to be so vocal and then I would "be all right."

rows.source: Amma ban shiga siyasa don na yi wannan abu ba.
rows.output: But I didn't get into politics because of this.
rows.reference: But that is not what I came into politics to do.

rows.source: Tun da ma na shiga jam’iyyar Labour shekaru 32 da suka wuce a matsayin wani yaro dan makaranta, da ya sami zaburarwa daga wazarai na gwamnatin Thatcher da a fakaice ta bar cikekken ajina na makaranta yana faɗuwa, na yi tunanin na zama gwarzon gyara ayyukan jama’a ga waɗanda ke buƙatar sosai - ko a matsayi na wani kansila na gida ko ministan gwamnati.
rows.output: Since I joined the Labour Party 32 years ago as a schoolboy, I had been inspired by the radicalism of the Thatcher government and the prospect of filling a whole classroom of unemployed people, I thought I was destined to be a champion of public services for those who needed them most - whether as a local councillor or a government minister.
rows.reference: Ever since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a school pupil, provoked by the Thatcher government's neglect that had left my comprehensive school classroom literally falling down, I've sought to champion better public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or government minister.

rows.source: Ban taɓa boye siyasata ba, har da cikin zaɓen da ya gabata.
rows.output: I have never hidden my politics, not even in the last election.
rows.reference: I have never hidden my politics, including at the last election.

rows.source: Ba wani daga cikin Nottingham ta Gabas da za a ce ya shiga ruɗani game da matsayin ƙudurina da yankuna na rashin amincewa tare da shugabancin yanzu.
rows.output: None of the Eastern Nottinghamshire members who are in the House of Commons are in any doubt about my position or the areas of disagreement with the current leadership.
rows.reference: No one in Nottingham East could have been in any way confused about my policy positions and areas of disagreement with the current leadership.

rows.source: Ga waɗanda suka tallata batu na ranar Juma’a, abin da dukka zan ce shi ne cewa a lokacin da ƙasar ke tattaki zuwa wani Brexit da zai cutar da iyalai, kasuwanci da ayyukan gwamnati, ban fahimci sha’awar ɓata lokaci da ƙarfin gwiwa ba a kan mubaya’a ta zuwa ga shugaban jam’iyyar Labour.
rows.output: To those who promoted the issue on Friday, what I would say is that at a time when the country is driving towards a Brexit that will harm families, businesses and public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on loyalty to the leader of the Labour Party.
rows.reference: To those who promoted the motion on Friday, all I would say is that when the country is ploughing towards a Brexit that will hurt households, businesses and our public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on my loyalty to the Labour party leader.

rows.source: Amma a zahiri kuwa saƙo ɗaya da nake da shi ba zuwa ga Nottingham Momentum ne ba, zuwa ga mazaɓata ne, ko mambobin Labour ko a’a: Ina alfahari da yin aiki don jama’a kuma na yi alkawari cewa ba wani irin barazana sake zaɓe ko ruɗanin siyasa da zai hana ni yin aiki a cikin abin da na yi imani da shi shi ne mafi kyawun abubuwan da za su yi wa jama’a dadi gaba ɗaya.
rows.output: But in fact, the only message I have is to the Nottingham Momentum, to the ward, to the members of the Labour Party or not: I am proud to work for the public and I have promised that no kind of threat or political deception will stop me from working in what I believe is the best thing for the public.
rows.reference: But really the one message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, it is to my constituents, whether Labour members or not: I am proud to serve you and I promise that no amount of deselection threats or political expediency will deter me from acting in what I believe are the best interests of you all.

rows.source: Tare da ƙarin damammakin aiki da za a iya samu masu buƙatar harsuna, wadannan hikimomi suna da muhimmanci a cikin duniya mai dunƙulewa.
rows.output: With more job opportunities available for language learners, these skills are essential in a globalized world.
rows.reference: With more prospective job opportunities requiring languages, these skills are essential in a globalised world.

rows.source: Ba tare da la’akari da irin aiki da wani ya zaɓa na rayuwa ba, idan suka koyi wani harshe na biyu, za su haƙiƙa wata fa’ida a nan gaba mai hikima ta tsawon rayuwa irin wannan:
rows.output: Regardless of the kind of work a person chooses to do, if they learn a second language, they will indeed gain a wise advantage in the future.
rows.reference: Regardless of the career someone chooses, if they've learned a second language, they'll have a real advantage in the future having a life-long skill such as this.

rows.source: Samun dama ta sadarwa kai tsaye tare da mutane daga ƙasashe na waje zai kai tsaye sa wani mutum mai harsuna da yawa a saman gasar.

rows.output: According to a YouGov poll of over 4,000 adults in England in 2013, 75% were unable to speak a foreign language well enough to have a conversation, with French being the only language spoken by 15% of respondents.

rows.source: Wannan shi ya sa zuba jari a cikin koyar da harshe a yanzu yana da amfani don yaran gobe.

rows.output: Having many languages, especially those of developing economies, can provide children with a great opportunity to find meaningful work.

rows.output: With many schools committed to increasing the prominence of modern languages, other schools will teach languages that are considered to be most useful for England in the future, such as Mandarin or Japanese, while looking ahead to 2020.

rows.source: Ko ma wace irin sha’awa yaranka ke da ita, koyaushe za a sami wasu harsuna na zaba daga cikin makarantu masu zaman kansu, tare da malamai masu koyarwa da suke kwararru a cikin yankin.
rows.output: No matter what your child's interests are, there will always be some languages to choose from in private schools, with teachers who are experts in the area.

rows.output: You can't do that right now, in a global business environment, languages are playing a more and more important role in the future of the country, so that has to be in the curriculum.

rows.source: Turai za ta sami wata fa’ida mai amfani a cikin ranar ta ƙarshe ta Ryder Cup bayan tasowa daga ƙwallaye huɗu na Asabar da wasannin huɗu-huɗu tare da wani ja gaba na 10 da 6 a cikin Amurka.
rows.output: Europe will have a useful advantage in the final day of the Ryder Cup after emerging from four-ball on Saturday and four foursomes with a 10-6 lead in the United States.
rows.reference: Europe will take a healthy advantage into the final day of the Ryder Cup after emerging from Saturday's fourballs and foursomes matches with a 10-6 lead over the United States.

rows.source: Su biyun da suka sami ƙarfin gwiwa Tommy Fleetwood da Francesco Molinari sun jagori canji da cin nasarori biyu a saman Tiger Woods da ke gwagwarmaya don ɗaukan lamba ya zuwa yanzu a Le Golf National zuwa ɗigo-ɗigo huɗu.
rows.output: The two who had the courage to take the lead were Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari, who changed the game with two birdies at the top of Tiger Woods, who was fighting to take the number one spot at Le Golf National to four digits.
rows.reference: Inspired duo Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari led the charge with two victories over a struggling Tiger Woods to take their tally so far at Le Golf National to four points.

rows.source: Sashen Turai na Thomas Bjorn, mai neman riƙe kofin ba su ci nasara ba a Hazeltine shekaru biyu da suka wuce, da mamaye wani rashin sa’a a sashen Amurka a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu na safe, inda suka ɗauki jere-jere 3 da 1.
rows.output: The European section of Thomas Bjorn, who were seeking to retain the cup, did not win at Hazeltine two years ago, and were plagued by a bad luck in the American section in four holes of the morning, where they took a 3-1 lead.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn's European side, bidding to retain the trophy they lost at Hazeltine two years ago, dominated a misfiring American side in the morning fourballs, taking the series 3-1.

rows.source: Amurka ta ƙara turjiya a cikin huɗu-huɗun, tana ci nasarar wasanni biyu, amma sun gagara ci a cikin tawayar.
rows.output: The United States added four more points in the fourth quarter, winning two games, but failed to score in the comeback.
rows.reference: The U.S. offered more resistance in the foursomes, winning two matches, but they could not eat into the deficit.

rows.source: Sashen Jim Furyk suna buƙatar ɗigo-ɗigo daga wasanni ɗaiɗaiku 12 na ranar Lahadi don riƙe kofin.
rows.output: The Jim Furyk Group needs to dig out from 12 individual games on Sunday to keep the cup.
rows.reference: Jim Furyk's side need eight points from Sunday's 12 singles matches to retain the trophy.

rows.source: Fleetwood shi ne farkon rookie na Turai da ya ci ɗigo-ɗigo huɗu a yayin da shi da Molinari, da aka cewa "Molliwood" bayan wani ƙarshen mako da ake magana kuma kawai su ne haɗin biyu da suka ci ɗigo-ɗigo hudu daga budewa wasanninsu huɗu a cikin tarihin Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Fleetwood was the first European rookie to win four holes in a row during the opening two days, along with Molinari, who was dubbed "Molliwood" after a weekend that was spoken of and the only pair to win four holes from the start of their four matches in the history of the Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Fleetwood is the first European rookie to win four points in a row while he and Molinari, dubbed "Molliwood" after a sensational weekend are only the second pair to win four points from their opening four matches in Ryder Cup history.

rows.source: Bayan sun buge Woods da Patrick Reed a cikin ƙwallaye huɗun sai kuma suka tashi suke buge Woods da rookie na Amurka Bryson Dechambeau ta kuma wani abin gani na 5 da 4.
rows.output: After hitting Woods and Patrick Reed in four holes, they then rose to hit Woods and American rookie Bryson DeChambeau in another spectacular 5 and 4.
rows.reference: Having crushed Woods and Patrick Reed in the fourballs they then gelled superbly to beat a deflated Woods and American rookie Bryson Dechambeau by an even more emphatic 5&4.

rows.source: Woods, wanda ya ja kansa zuwa cikin wasanni biyu a ranar Asabar, ya nuna wata bayyana ta ilimi amma yanzu ya rasa 19 na wasanninsa a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu da wasannin huɗu-huɗu da bakwai a cikin wani jeri.
rows.output: Woods, who pulled himself into two games on Saturday, showed a display of academic knowledge but now has lost 19 of his games in four-point and four-quarter games and seven in a row in a streak.
rows.reference: Woods, who dragged himself through two matches on Saturday, showed occasional bursts of brilliance but he has now lost 19 of his 29 matches in fourballs and foursomes and seven in a row.

rows.source: Justin Rose, ya huta don ƙwallaye huɗu na safen, ya dawo ga abokin hulɗa Henrik Stenson a cikin wasannin huɗu-huɗu zuwa ga wata dokewa 2 da 1 ci na Dustin Johnson da Brooks Koepka - mai kima ɗaya da uku a cikin duniya.
rows.output: Justin Rose, who had four birdies in the round, was joined by fellow Englishman Henrik Stenson in the four-man race to be crowned the Open champion. They were two strokes behind the leader, Dustin Johnson, and Brooks Koepka, who were both ranked number one and three in the world.
rows.reference: Justin Rose, rested for the morning fourballs, returned to partner Henrik Stenson in the foursomes to a 2&1 defeat of Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka - ranked one and three in the world.

rows.source: Turai ba ta samu ba yadda take da sauki, ranar kudu-maso-yamma mai iska ta Paris.
rows.output: Europe has not had a summer as easy as the southwest of France, the windy Parisian day.
rows.reference: Europe did not have it al their own way though on a pleasant, breezy day south west of Paris.

rows.source: Babban mai cin nasara sau uku Jordan Spieth da Justin Thomas sun kafa wani layi don Amurkawa tare da ɗigo-ɗigo biyu a ranar Asabar.
rows.output: Three-time major winner Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas set up an American charge with two-under-par rounds on Saturday.
rows.reference: Three-times major winner Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas set the benchmark for the Americans with two points on Saturday.

rows.source: Sun sami wani ci da ba daɗi na 2 da 1 a kan Jon Rahm Ian Poulter na Spain a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu da kuma dawowa daga baya don buge Poulter da Rory McIlroy 4 da 3 a cikin wasannin huɗu-huɗu bayan su rasa cin nasara ta buɗewa ramukan biyu.
rows.output: They had a disappointing 2 and 1 loss to Spain's Jon Rahm and Ian Poulter in four holes, and then came back later to beat Poulter and Rory McIlroy 4 and 3 in four-ball after losing the opening two holes.
rows.reference: They earned a gritty 2&1 win over Spain's Jon Rahm and Ian Poulter in the fourballs and returned later to beat Poulter and Rory McIlroy 4&3 in the foursomes having lost the opening two holes.

rows.source: Kawai sau ɗaya ne a tarihin Ryder Cup wata ƙungiya ta sake dawowa daga wani rasa ɗigo huɗu a cikin ɗaiɗaiku,  kodayake kamar yadda masu riƙon na sashen Furyk ke buƙatar kawai tsayuwar doki don riƙe kofin.
rows.output: Only once in the history of the Ryder Cup has a team come back from a four-point deficit in singles, although as the holders of the section Furyk needed only a steady horse to retain the cup.
rows.reference: Only twice in Ryder Cup history has a team come back from a four-point deficit going into the singles, although as holders Furyk's side need only draw to retain the trophy.

rows.source: Bayan kasancewa na biyu mafi kyau na kwanaki biyu, amma, wani sake hari na ranar Lahadi ya yi kamar dai zai fi ƙarfinsu.
rows.output: After being the second best for two days, but, a Sunday attack was like it would be their strongest.
rows.reference: After being second-best for two days, however, a Sunday counter-attack looks as though it will be beyond them.

rows.source: Koriya ta Arewa ta ce ‘ba yadda’ za ta rage makami ita kaɗai ba tare da aminci ba
rows.output: North Korea said it would not unilaterally disarm without a guarantee of its security
rows.reference: North Korea says 'no way' will disarm unilaterally without trust

rows.source: Ministan Harkokin Ƙasashen Waje na Koriya ta Arewa ya faɗa wa Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a ranar Asabar ci gaba da takunkumi yana ƙara tura rashin amincewarta da Amurka kuma babu wata hanya da ƙasar za ta bar makamanta na nukiliya ita kaɗai a ƙarƙashin ire-iren yanayin.
rows.output: The North Korean Foreign Minister told the United Nations on Saturday that continued sanctions are pushing the country further into the arms of the United States and that there is no way the country will give up its nuclear weapons under any circumstances.
rows.reference: North Korea's foreign minister told the United Nations on Saturday continued sanctions were deepening its mistrust in the United States and there was no way the country would give up its nuclear weapons unilaterally under such circumstances.

rows.source: Ri Yong ya faɗa wa Babban Taro na shekara na na hukumar duniya cewa Koriya ta Arewa ta yi “masu matakai na mutunci” a cikin shekarar ta da wuce, kamar tsaida gwaje-gwajen nukiliya da makamai masu linzami, rusa wurin gwajin nukiliya, kuma da yin alkawari ba za ta ƙara makaman nukiliya da fasahar nukiliya ba.
rows.output: Ri Yong told the UN General Assembly that North Korea had taken "important steps for peace" in the previous year, such as halting nuclear tests and missiles, dismantling a nuclear test site, and promising not to add more nuclear weapons and technology.
rows.reference: Ri Yong Ho told the world body's annual General Assembly that North Korea had taken "significant goodwill measures" in the past year, such as stopping nuclear and missiles tests, dismantling the nuclear test site, and pledging not to proliferate nuclear weapons and nuclear technology.

rows.source: "Amma, ba mu ga kowane abu na martani daga Amurka,” inji shi.
rows.output: "But we haven't seen any response from the U.S.," he said.
rows.reference: "However, we do not see any corresponding response from the U.S.," he said.

rows.source: “Ba tare da kowane aminci ba na Amurka ba za a sami ƙarfin gwiwa a cikin tsaronmu na ƙasa kuma a ƙarƙashin ire-iren yanayin babu wata hanya da mu kaɗai za mu rage makamai mu da farko.”
rows.output: “Without the security of the United States, there will be no strength in our national defense and under any circumstances, there is no way for us to reduce our weapons first.”
rows.reference: "Without any trust in the U.S. there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first."

rows.source: A yayin da Rike same maimaita koke-koken Koriya ta Kudu da aka sani game da ƙin Washington na bin wata hanyar “a hankali” don rage makaman nukiliyat a ƙarƙashinsa da za a ba da kyauta ga Koriya ta Arewan a yayin da ɗauki wasu matakai a hankali, jawabin nasa ya bayyana da muhimmanci saboda ba ta ƙi rage makaman nukiliyar ita kaɗai ba haka kawai kamar yadda Pyongyang ɗin ta yi a baya ba.
rows.output: While Rike repeated the familiar South Korean complaints about Washington's failure to follow a "phased" approach to dismantling its nuclear arsenal and to provide a reward for North Korea, his own remarks were important because they did not simply echo Pyongyang's previous denials of any interest in reducing its nuclear weapons.
rows.reference: While Ri reprised familiar North Korean complaints about Washington's resistance to a "phased" approach to denuclearization under which North Korea would be rewarded as it took gradual steps, his statement appeared significant in that it did not reject unilateral denuclearization out of hand as Pyongyang has done in the past.

rows.source: Ri ya yi dube ne ga wani jawabin hadin gwiwa daga Kim Jong Un da Donald Trump a wani babban taro da aka taba yi tsakanin shugaban Amurka mai ci da wani shugaban Koriya ta Arewa a cikin Singapore a ranar 12 ga Yuni, a lokacin da Kim ya yi alkawari yin aiki zuwa ga "rage makaman nukiliya a zirin Koriya" a lokacin da Trump ya yi alkawarin ba da garanti na tsaron Koriya ta Arewa din.
rows.output: The US and North Korea have agreed to a joint statement from Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump at a summit between the US president and North Korean leader in Singapore on June 12, in which Kim pledged to work towards "the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula" while Trump promised to provide a security guarantee for North Korea.
rows.reference: Ri referred to a joint statement issued by Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump at a first ever summit between a serving U.S. president and a North Korean leader in Singapore on June 12, when Kim pledged to work toward "denuclearization of the Korean peninsula" while Trump promised guarantees of North Korea's security.

rows.source: Koriya ta Arewa tana neman wani kawo wa ƙarshen Yakin Koriya na shekarun 1950 zuwa 53, amma Amurkan ta ce Pyongyang dole ta bar makamanta na nukiliya daga farko.
rows.output: North Korea is seeking a way to end the Korean War of 1950-53, but the US says Pyongyang must first give up its nuclear weapons.
rows.reference: North Korea has been seeking a formal end to the 1950-53 Korea War, but the United States has said Pyongyang must give up its nuclear weapons first.

rows.source: Haka kuma Washington ta ki kiraye-kiraye na ta sassauta takunkumin ƙasa-da-ƙasa a kan Koriya ta Arewa.
rows.output: And Washington also rejected calls to ease international sanctions on North Korea.
rows.reference: Washington has also resisted calls to relax tough international sanctions on North Korea.

rows.source: “Amurka ta jajirce a kan “barin nukiliya daga farko” kuma ta ƙara matakin matsai ta takunkumi don cimma manufarta a cikin halin tilastawa, da kuma ma ƙin “furuci na ƙarshen yaƙi,”” inji Ri.
rows.output: "United States is committed to 'zero nuclear first use' and has increased the level of deterrence to achieve its goal in a coercive manner, and to reject the 'endgame rhetoric,' said R.
rows.reference: "The U.S. insists on the "denuclearization-first" and increases the level of pressure by sanctions to achieve their purpose in a coercive manner, and even objecting to the "declaration of the end of war,"" Ri said.

rows.source: “Fahimta ta cewa takunkumi zai iya kawo mu kan gwiwowinmu wani mafarki ne na mutane waɗanda suka zahilci abu game da mu.
rows.output: "Understanding that restrictions can bring us to our knees is a dream of people who have been ignorant about us.
rows.reference: "The perception that sanctions can bring us on our knees is a pipe dream of the people who are ignorant about us.

rows.source: Amma matsalar ita ce ci gaba da takunkumi suna kara rashin yardarmu.”
rows.output: But the problem is that the continued restrictions are only making us more unpopular.
rows.reference: But the problem is that the continued sanctions are deepening our mistrust."

rows.source: Ri bai yi furuci na shirye-shirye don wani babban taro na biyu tsakanin Kim da Trump wanda shugaban Amurka da ya tsokaci a Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a cikin farkon makon.
rows.output: He did not make any specific preparations for a second summit between Kim and Trump, who is scheduled to speak to the United Nations General Assembly in the first week of September.
rows.reference: Ri made no mention of plans for a second summit between Kim and Trump that the U.S. leader highlighted at the United Nations earlier in the week.

rows.source: A maimakon haka ministan ya yi tsokaci ne na taruka uku tsakanin Kim da shugaban Koriya ta Kudu Moon Jae-in a cikin watanni biyar da suka wuce kuma ya ƙara da cewa: “Idan kasar da ke cikin wannan batun na barin nukiliya za a ce Koriya ta Kudu ne ba Amurka ba da barin nukiliyar na zirin Koriya da ba sami irin matsalar ba.”
rows.output: Instead, the minister made a reference to three meetings between Kim and South Korean President Moon Jae-in in the past five months and added that: "If a country in this matter is leaving nuclear weapons, it would be South Korea, not the United States, leaving nuclear weapons on the Korean Peninsula that did not have a problem."
rows.reference: The minister instead highlighted three meetings between Kim and South Korean leader Moon Jae-in in the past five months and added: "If the party to this issue of denuclearization were South Korea and not the U.S., the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula would not have come to such a deadlock."

rows.source: Duk da haka, lafazin jawabin na Ri ya dan zama daban daga na shekarar da ta gabata, a lokacin da ya gaya wa Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniyar cewa cikin yankin Amurka da rokokin Koriya wani abu ne da dole zai wakana bayan “Mista Shugaba Mai Neman Bala’i” Trup ya kira Kim da wani “mutum mai roka” da ke neman kashe kansa.
rows.output: However, the tone of Ri's speech was slightly different from that of the previous year, when he told the General Assembly of the United Nations that something had to be done about the "Mr. President of the Apocalypse" Trup's call for Kim to be a "rogue" who was seeking to commit suicide.
rows.reference: Even so, the tone of Ri's speech was dramatically different from last year, when he told the U.N. General Assembly that targeting the U.S. mainland with North Korea's rockets was inevitable after "Mr Evil President" Trump called Kim a "rocket man" on a suicide mission.

rows.source: Wannan shekarar a Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya, Trump, wanda shekarar da ta gabata ya yi barazana ta “rusa gaba ɗaya” Koriya ta Arewa, ya yabi Kim don karfin halinsa na ɗaukan matakai na rage makamai, amma ya ce har yanzu a akwai aiki da dole za a yi kuma takunkumi suna nan sa har Koriya ta Arewan ta bar nukiliya.
rows.output: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who last year threatened to "completely destroy" North Korea, praised Kim for his strength in taking steps to reduce weapons, but said that there is still work to be done and that sanctions will remain in place until North Korea gives up nuclear weapons.
rows.reference: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who last year threatened to "totally destroy" North Korea, heaped praise on Kim for his courage in taking steps to disarm, but said much work still had to be done and sanctions must remain in place until North Korea denuclearizes.

rows.source: A ranar Laraba, Trump ya ce ba ya da lokaci ƙayyadedde don wannan, yana cewa “Idan zai ɗauki shekaru biyu, shekaru uku ko shekaru biyar - ba damuwa.”
rows.output: On Wednesday, Trump said he didn't have a specific timeline for this, saying, "If it takes two years, three years or five years - no problem."
rows.reference: On Wednesday, Trump said he did not have a time frame for this, saying "If it takes two years, three years or five months - doesn't matter."

rows.source: China da Rasha sun yi mahawara cewa ya kamata Kwamitin Tsaro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ya ba da kyauta ga Pyongyang don matakan da ta ɗauka.
rows.output: China and Russia argued that the United Nations Security Council should grant Pyongyang a reward for the measures it has taken.
rows.reference: China and Russia argue that the U.N. Security Council should reward Pyongyang for steps taken.

rows.source: Amma, Sakataren Ƙasashen Waje na Amurka  Mike Pompeo ya faɗa wa Kwamitin Tsaro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a ranar Alhamis cewa: “Dole tilasta takunkumin Kwamitin Tsaro ya ci gaba sosai ba tare da gazawa ba sai har mun ga cikekken barin nukiliya da aka tantance daga ƙarshe.”
rows.output: But, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the United Nations Security Council on Thursday that: "The sanctions of the Security Council must be enforced vigorously and without exception until we see a complete, verified, and irreversible dismantlement of nuclear weapons."
rows.reference: However, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the U.N. Security Council on Thursday that: "Enforcement of Security Council sanctions must continue vigorously and without fail until we realize the fully, final, verified denuclearization."

rows.source: Kwamitin Tsaro gaba daya ya sa karfafa takunkumi ne a kan Koriya ta Arewa tun 2006 a wani yinkuri na dakile samun kudi don shirye-shiryen Pyongyang na nukiliya da makamin fashewa mai linzami.
rows.output: The United Nations Security Council has imposed sanctions on North Korea since 2006 in an effort to curb funding for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs.
rows.reference: The Security Council has unanimously boosted sanctions on North Korea since 2006 in a bid to choke off funding for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs.

rows.source: Pompeo ya haɗu da Ri a gefen Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya inda ya ce bayan hakan zai sake ziyartar Pyongyang wata mai zuwa don shirya wani babban taro na biyu.
rows.output: Pompeo met with Ri on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly, where he said after that he would again visit Pyongyang next month to prepare for a second summit.
rows.reference: Pompeo met Ri on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly and said afterwards that he would visit Pyongyang again next month to prepare for a second summit.

rows.source: Pompeo ya ziyarci Koriya ta Arewa sau uku tun tuni wannan shekarar, amma zuwan nasa bai yi daɗi sosai ba.
rows.output: Pompeo has visited North Korea three times this year, but his visit was not well received.
rows.reference: Pompeo has visited North Korea three times already this year, but his last trip did not go well.

rows.source: Ya bar Pyongyang a cikin Yuli yana mai cewa an samu ci gaba, kawai sai dai a cikin sa’o’i Koriya ta Arewa ta yi watsi da neman “buƙatu kamar na 'yan daba.”
rows.output: He left Pyongyang in July saying that progress had been made, only to be rebuffed hours later by North Korea in its demand for "demands like those of a terrorist."
rows.reference: He left Pyongyang in July saying that progress had been made, only for North Korea within hours to denounce him for making "gangster-like demands."

rows.source: Koriya ta Arewa ta yi alkawari a wani mitin tare da Moon wannan watan za ta ruguza wani wuri na gwajin makami mai linzami da kuma wani gini na nukiliya idan Amurka ta ɗauki “wasu matakai ta ɓangaren.”
rows.output: North Korea has promised in a statement that it will demolish a nuclear test site and a nuclear facility if the United States takes "some corresponding measures."
rows.reference: North Korea pledged in a meeting with Moon this month to dismantle a missile site and also a nuclear complex if the United States took "corresponding measures."

rows.source: Ya ce Kim ya faɗa masa "wasu matakai ta ɓangaren" da yake nema su ne garanti na tsaro da Trump ya yi alkawari a Singapore da kuma yin motsi zuwa ga daidaita hulɗoɗi tare da Washington.
rows.output: He said Kim had told him "certain steps" that he was looking for were a guarantee of security that Trump had promised in Singapore and movement towards normalizing relations with Washington.
rows.reference: He said Kim had told him the "corresponding measures" he was seeking were security guarantees Trump pledged in Singapore and moves toward normalization of relations with Washington.

rows.source: Daliban Harvard sun ɗauki kwas a kan samun isasshen barci
rows.output: Harvard students took a course on getting enough sleep
rows.reference: Harvard students take course in getting enough rest

rows.source: Wani sabon kwas a Jami’ar Harvard wannan shekarar ya samar wa dukkan ɗalibansa samun ƙarin barci a cikin wani yinƙuri na dakile girman al’adar ƙarti ta karatu ta hanyar shan kafen ‘dukkan dare.’
rows.output: A new course at Harvard University this year has provided all its students with more sleep in an effort to curb the growing trend of studying late into the night by drinking coffee.
rows.reference: A new course at Harvard University this year has got all its undergraduates getting more sleep in a bid to combat the growing macho culture of studying through caffeine-fuelled 'all-nighters.'

rows.source: Wani malami ya sami ɗalibai a jami’a ta daya a duniyar yawanci ba su san kome ba idan an zo maganar muhimman abubuwa game da yadda za su kula da kansu.
rows.output: A professor once found students at a top university in the world generally didn't know much when it came to important things about how to take care of themselves.
rows.reference: An academic found students at the world's number one university are often clueless when it comes to the very basics about how to look after themselves.

rows.source: Charles Czeisler, farfesa na maganin barci a Makarantar Koyon Aikin Likita ta Harvard kuma wani kwararre a Brigham da Asibitin Mata, shi ne ya tsara kwas din, wanda ya yi imani shi ne na farko irinsa a cikin Amurka.
rows.output: Charles Czeisler, a professor of sleep medicine at Harvard Medical School and a specialist at Brigham and Women's Hospital, was the architect of the program, which he believed was the first of its kind in the United States.
rows.reference: Charles Czeisler, professor of sleep medicine at Harvard Medical School and a specialist at the Brigham and Women's Hospital, designed the course, which he believes is the first of its kind in the US.

rows.source: An janyo hankalinsa ya fara kwas ɗin bayan ya yi jawabi a kan tasiri na hana barci a kan koyon ilmi.
rows.output: He was drawn to the course after giving a talk on the effects of sleep deprivation on learning.
rows.reference: He was inspired to start the course after giving a talk on the impact sleep deprivation had on learning.

rows.source: ‘Daga ƙarshe wata yarinya guda ɗaya ta zo ta same ni ta ce: ‘Me ya sa sai yanzu aka gaya mun wannan, a cikin shekarata ta karshe?’
rows.output: Finally, one young girl came and found me and said: 'Why is it that we have only just been told this in our last year?'
rows.reference: 'At the end of it one girl came up to me and said: 'Why am I only being told this now, in my senior year?'

rows.source: Ta ce ba wanda ya taɓa gaya mata game da amfani na barci - abin da ya ba ta mamaki,’ ta faɗa wa The Telegraph.
rows.output: She said no one had ever told her about the use of sleep - what surprised her,' she told The Telegraph.
rows.reference: She said no one had ever told her about the importance of sleep - which surprised me,' he told The Telegraph.

rows.source: Kwas ɗin ya fara ne yin lokacin farko a wannan shekarar, inda aka yi bayani ga dalibai fa’idoji na yadda halaye masu kyau na barci ke taimakon aikin koyon ilimi da wasan tsalle-tsalle, har ma da inganta lafiyarsu gaba ɗaya.
rows.output: The course began with a first session this year, where students were informed of the benefits of good sleep habits in helping with learning and athletic performance, as well as improving their overall health.
rows.reference: The course, rolled out for the first time this year, explains to students the essentials of how good sleep habits help academic and athletic performance, as well as improve their general wellbeing.

rows.source: Paul Barreira, farfesan ilmin mahaukata a Makarantar Koyon Aikin Asibiti ta Harvard kuma babban darakta na ayyukan lafiya na jami’ar, ya ce jami’ar ta yanke hukunci ne na gabatar da kwas ɗin bayan ta gano ana matuƙar hana ɗalibai yin barci a lokacin mako.
rows.output: Paul Barreira, a professor of psychiatry at the Harvard Medical School's Department of Psychiatry and the director of the school's Center for Medical Ethics, said the school decided to offer the course after finding that students were being severely sleep-deprived during the week.
rows.reference: Paul Barreira, professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School and executive director of the university's health services, said the university decided to introduce the course after finding students were seriously sleep deprived during the week.

rows.source: Kwas mai tsawon sa’a ɗayan ya haɗa ne da jerin wasu ayyukan tattaunawa.

rows.output: The Pamans and the Donggala have experienced tsunamis in the past 100 years, according to Indonesia's Disaster Mitigation Agency.
rows.reference: Palu and Donggala have been hit by tsunamis several times in the past 100 years, according to Indonesia's Disaster Mitigation Agency.

rows.source: A 1938, tsunami ya kashe mutane fiye da 200 kuma ya hallaka daruruwan gidaje a Donggala.
rows.output: In 1938, a tsunami killed more than 200 people and destroyed hundreds of homes in Donggala.
rows.reference: In 1938, a tsunami killed more than 200 people and destroyed hundreds of houses in Donggala.

rows.source: Wani tsunami kuma ya bugi yammacin Donggala a shekarar 1996, ya kashe mutane tara.
rows.output: A tsunami also struck the west coast of Donggala in 1996, killing nine people.

rows.source: Indonesia na zaune a kan tsaunuka na Pacific Ring na Wuta kuma girgizar kasa na yawan samunsu.
rows.output: Indonesia is located on the Pacific Ring of Fire and is prone to earthquakes.
rows.reference: Indonesia sits on the seismically Pacific Ring of Fire and is regularly hit by earthquakes.

rows.source: Ga wasu manyan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami a cikin 'yan shekarun nan:
rows.output: Here are some of the major earthquakes and tsunamis in recent years:

rows.source: 2004: Babban girgizar kasa a yammacin tekun Aceh dake arewacin Sumatra a ranar 26 ga Disamban bara ya haifar da tsunami wanda ya shafi kasashe 14, inda ya kashe mutane 226,000 a bakin tekun Indiya, fiye da rabin su a Aceh.
rows.output: 2004: A major earthquake off the coast of Aceh in northern Sumatra on December 26 caused a tsunami that affected 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along the Indian Ocean, with more than half of the deaths in Aceh.
rows.reference: 2004: A major quake on the western coast of Indonesia's Aceh province in northern Sumatra on Dec. 26 triggered a tsunami that struck 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along Indian Ocean coastline, more than half of them in Aceh.

rows.source: 2005: Jerin girgizar kasa ya faru a yammacin tsibirin Sumatra a cikin karshen Maris da farkon Afrilu.
rows.output: 2005: A series of earthquakes occurred in western Sumatra in late March and early April.
rows.reference: 2005: A series of strong quakes hit the western coast of Sumatra in late March and early April.

rows.source: Daruruwa sun mutu a tsibirin Nias, a bakin tekun Sumatra.
rows.output: The tribes died out on the island of Nias, off the coast of Sumatra.
rows.reference: Hundreds died in Nias Island, off the coast of Sumatra.

rows.source: 2006: Girman 6.8 auku a kudancin Java, tsibirin da yafi kowanne cika a Indonesia, wanda ya haifar da tsunami wanda ya shiga har kudancin bakin teku, inda ya kashe kusan mutane 700.
rows.output: 2006: An earthquake of 6.8 magnitude occurred in southern Java, the most populous island in Indonesia, triggering a tsunami that affected the entire southern coast, resulting in the deaths of about 700 people.
rows.reference: 2006: A 6.8 magnitude hit south of Java, Indonesia's most populated island, triggering a tsunami that smashed into the southern coast, killing nearly 700 people.

rows.source: 2009: Girgizar kasa mai girma ta 7.6 ta auku a kusa da birnin Padang, babban birnin lardin yammacin Sumatra.
rows.output: 2009: A 7.6 magnitude earthquake occurred near the city of Padang, the capital of West Sumatra province.
rows.reference: 2009: A 7.6 magnitude quake struck near the city of Padang, capital of West Sumatra province.

rows.source: Fiye da mutane 1,100 aka kashe.
rows.output: More than 1,100 people have been killed.
rows.reference: More than 1,100 people were killed.

rows.source: 2010: Girgizar kasa mai girma ta 7.5 ta auku a daya daga cikin tsibirin Mentawai, daga Sumatra, inda ta haifar da tsunami har zuwa mita 10 da suka lalata kananan garuruwa masu yawa kuma suka kashe kimanin mutane 300.
rows.output: 2010: A major earthquake of 7.5 magnitude occurred in one of the Mentawai Islands, off Sumatra, triggering a tsunami of up to 10 meters that destroyed several small villages and killed about 300 people.
rows.reference: 2010: A 7.5 magnitude quake hit one of the Mentawai islands, off Sumatra, triggering up tsunami of up to 10 meters that destroyed dozens of villages and killed around 300 people.

rows.source: 2016: Wani mummunan girgizar kasa ya auku a yankin Pidie Jaya a Aceh, ya haddasa rugurgujewar abubuwa da tsoro yayin da aka tunatar da mutane game da mummunan girgizar kasa da tsunami da ta auku a 2004.
rows.output: 2016: A devastating earthquake struck the Pidie Jaya region in Aceh, causing widespread damage and panic as people were reminded of the devastating earthquake and tsunami that occurred in 2004.
rows.reference: 2016: A shallow quake hit the Pidie Jaya regency in Aceh, causing destruction and panic as people were reminded by the devastation of the deadly 2004 quake and tsunami.

rows.source: Ba a sami tsunami ba a wannan lokaci, amma fiye da mutane 100 suka mutu sakamakon gine-ginen da suka fadi.

rows.reference: No tsunami was triggered this time, but more than 100 were killed by fallen buildings.

rows.source: 2018: Babban girgizar kasar ya auku a tsibirin Lombok dake Indonesiya, inda ya kashe mutane sama da 500, mafi yawa a arewacin tsibirin.
rows.output: 2018: A major earthquake struck the island of Lombok in Indonesia, killing more than 500 people, mostly in the northern part of the island.
rows.reference: 2018: Major quakes hit Indonesia's tourist island of Lombok, killing more than 500 people, mostly on the northern side of the island.

rows.source: Girgizar ta ruguza dubban gine-gine kuma ta bar dubban masu 'yan yawon bude ido cikin wani hali na dan lokaci.

rows.reference: The quake destroyed thousands of buildings and left thousands of tourists temporarily stranded.

rows.source: An kama babban dan Sarah Palin kan tuhumar rikicin cikin gida

rows.output: Track Palin, son of former Alaska governor and Republican vice presidential candidate Sarah Palin, was arrested on charges of domestic violence.
rows.reference: Track Palin, the eldest son of former Alaska governor and vice presidential candidate Sarah Palin, has been arrested on assault charges.

rows.source: An kama Palin, mai shekaru 29, na Wasilla, Alaska, kan zargin da ake yi na tada hankalin cikin gida, tare da yin katsalandan ga rahotannin tada hankali cikin gida da, a cewar wani rahoton da Alaska State Troopers ta fitar, a ranar Asabar.

rows.reference: Palin, 29, of Wasilla, Alaska, was arrested on suspicion of domestic violence, interfering with a report of domestic violence and resisting arrest, according to a report released Saturday by Alaska State Troopers.

rows.source: A cewar rahoton 'yan sanda, idan wata mata tayi kokarin ta kira' yan sanda don bayar da rahoton laifukan da ake zargin, sai ya dauki wayarta daga gareta
rows.output: According to the police report, if a woman tries to call the police to report alleged crimes, they will take her phone away from her.

rows.source: An sa Palin a cikin Mat-Su Pretrial Facility kuma ana gudanar da shi a kan yarjejeniyar takardar alkawali na $500, in ji KTUU.
rows.output: Palin was placed in the Mat-Su Pretrial Facility and is being held on a $500 personal recognizance bond, according to KTUU.
rows.reference: Palin is being remanded in Mat-Su Pretrial Facility and is being held on a $500 unsecured bond, reported KTUU.

rows.source: Ya bayyana a kotu a ranar Asabar, inda ya bayyana kansa "ba laifi ba, a gaskiya" lokacin da aka neme shi, ruwaitowar cibiyar sadarwa.
rows.output: He appeared in court on Saturday, where he described himself as "not guilty, in fact" when asked, according to the wire service.

rows.source: Palin yana fuskantar nau'o'i uku na Aji na, ma'ana zai iya tsare shi har zuwa shekara guda kuma ya biya $ 250,000.
rows.output: Palin is facing three classes of Class A, meaning he can be held for up to a year and pay $250,000.
rows.reference: Palin faces three Class A misdemeanours, meaning he could be imprisoned for up to a year and fined $250,000.

rows.source: Ana kuma tuhuma shi da wani mummunan lakabi na Ajin B, wanda hukunci shi ne ya je kurkuku na rana guda da kuma tarar $2,000.
rows.output: He is also charged with a Class B misdemeanor, which carries a sentence of one day in jail and a fine of $2,000.
rows.reference: He has also been charged with a Class B misdemeanour, punishable by a day in jail and a $2,000 fine.

rows.source: Ba shi ne karo na farko da aka gurfanar da Palin ba akan mayan laifuka.
rows.output: It is not the first time that Palin has been charged with a crime.

rows.source: A watan Janairu 2016 an zargi shi da aikata laifuka na gida, da rikici da rahoto game da aikata ta'addanci a cikin gida, da kuma samun makamin yayin da yake cike da haɗari dangane da wannan lamarin.

rows.source: Budurwar shi ta yi zargin cewa ya doke ta a fuska.
rows.output: She accused him of cheating her.

rows.source: An soki Sarah Palin a lamarin ta hanyar kungiyoyin tsofaffin soja a shekara ta 2016 bayan ya haɗu da halayyar danginta ga PTSD daga aikinsa a Iraki.
rows.output: Sarah Palin was criticized in 2016 by a group of former soldiers for her association with her family's behavior towards PTSD from her service in Iraq.

rows.output: Electricity and communications have been disrupted, with more casualties expected in the coming days.
